Question: Assalam Alikum, Mufti saheb my husband, is behind my mom, he torcher her in my absence, he use to tell my mother to show of her private parts, my mother is afrid of this act. Plz tell me how to get rid of this problem. He thinks im unaware of this things. Answer ID: 11961 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 766/641=D/1430) Ask your mother to observe purdah (hijab) from your husband and avoid talking to him. Use every means you can do to stop her, otherwise it is feared that your husband commits any wrong act and you will be haram on your husband forever, the rulings about in-laws are sensitive. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
